stemMd: Why does a missing repair entry not prove that an object remained intact?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every page of the books was illegible.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Damage could have led to disposal instead of recorded repair.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The researcher had already measured every object's durability.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Repairs were prohibited in the museum.

explanationMd: The recording process captures repairs, not all damage. A damaged object discarded without repair would leave no entry of the kind being examined.

distractorRationale.c: The original measurement plan was revised.
